answer: A phone number becomes an identity only when its carrier presses twelve months of continuous activity into the shale: a signed attestation the registry checks for signature, tenure, and a number no other identity claims. Then the fable test: the applicant retells three dated facts from the SIM’s own history — first tower, busiest month, home district — against the carrier’s sealed copy. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 1,000 aged SIMs at $40 each, $40,000, plus 1,000 learned fables, no bulk rate; an honest agent crosses the carrier bridge once, free.
